meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate in principle for RIO.L: a genuine 19 Feb 2026 Annual Report (a395d7da4dca5b2b, priority 120), 20-F, H1 2026 results (e36747cb4ebb850b), H1 slides, and Q2 production body all exist with has_body=true in the trial tree. It is not adequate in practice: period_coverage annual=20 / interim=47 / trading_update=0 counts AGM notices/results, Payments to Governments, a Supplementary Prospectus, SVM “Rio collab concludes”, and the Tomago power RNS as annual, and dumps ~40 SEC 6-Ks plus three IR-allowlist year-end HTMs (rio-2023/24/25, null published_at) into interim. Production reports that should be trading_update sit as interim. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow sits on the ladder but is empty (expected for a USD half-year reporter) while alternate_news is absent. filings_index.body_path values point at docs/data/research/RIO.L or output/research/RIO.L rather than this trial tree, and source_inventory counts 113 body files vs 118 indexed bodies even though every indexed basename is present.

The screen emits strong_buy (11/22, five families, composite 0.679 vs a higher sector composite 0.725) on a 1-week new print while the snapshot summary already records a dividend-yield overlay to Buy because FCF yield and earnings quality failed. The snapshot then overwrites that brake: failed_models=[], adjusted_signal=strong_buy, conviction_score 0.689 versus summary “Conviction 44%”, and action_note/research_* are pre-seeded with repeated prior-memo “Accumulate, Medium risk” boilerplate. cyclical_exposure_detected=false and every overlay flag is false on a bulk-commodity major. Director–worker qualitative veto is doing the work a cyclical + FCF-vs-dividend + unit-hygiene overlay already half-did, then undid.

Mandatory annual+interim summarize_filing_body plus news+screen+gap consumes the five-task cap even when the right FY and H1 bodies are chosen. There is no type or period flag for trading_update (Q1/Q2 production), 20-F, rns_cluster (PDMR/TVR/employee shares), mineral-resources, power_contract (Tomago/Boyne), or catalog_period_mismatch (Tomago/SVM/AGM tagged annual; IR 20-F HTMs tagged interim). gap_inventory can only list that the 20-F, H1 presentation, Q2 production, mineral-resources update, and Tomago/Boyne RNSs were dropped — it cannot assign them.

weeks_at_signal=1 / stability=new / improving already marks a fresh print, but there is no watch schema for: mid-October Q3 production (absent from a 4 Sep 17:26Z fetch), 2026 guidance vs cyclone-held levels, FCF vs the 4.6% dividend after H1, net-debt path after 15bn Yahoo net debt, Glencore standstill follow-up, Tomago/Boyne cash calls, Morgan Stanley ADR PT vs LSE pence limits, dual-list (RIO.L / RIO.AX / NYSE:RIO) price divergence, or snapshot adjusted_signal disagreeing with the overlay text in the same object. This trial re-asks the same 17:26Z catalog without new evidence.
